kit.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Full Stack Engineer / Tech Intern position at IONIC. As an MCA student at PES University with a CGPA of 8.48 and hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team.

During my professional experience as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings. Additionally, as a freelance full-stack developer, I delivered a Point of Sale system using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server, deployed on Azure. My project work includes building Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform, and StaySphere, a property rental platform, both utilizing the MERN stack and secure authentication practices.

My background in developing scalable web applications, implementing REST APIs, and working with modern databases aligns well with the requirements for this role. I am available for the paid internship matching my stipend expectations and am ready to work on-site in Bangalore.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and background match your team's needs.

Sincerely,
Amaanuddin Ahmed
